questions.prompt: Effective stack between you and one opponent is…

choices.text: The smaller of the two stacks.

questions.explanation: You can only win what the shorter player can put in.

choices.text: One player is all-in and others continue betting.

questions.explanation: Extra chips between the covering players go into a side pot the all-in player cannot win.

questions.prompt: Unmatched chips that cannot be called are…

choices.text: Left in the pot as a bonus.

questions.explanation: If nobody can call the extra, that extra comes back.

questions.prompt: You cover two all-in opponents who have different stacks. You might win…

choices.text: Nothing if you have the best hand.
A single combined pot with no eligibility rules.
The main pot and a side pot, depending on who you beat.

questions.explanation: Each pot is awarded only among players who contributed to it.
